inspection.note: RGB values are linear diffuse irradiance using the surface geometry normal, before material normal maps, colour, ambient fill and tone mapping. Exact blends use geometry visibility and the same baked probe coefficients; they are not fresh environment captures. Floor blends preserve weak probe support through confidence attenuation; unboundedRGB shows the blend before this attenuation.

reference.name: upper wall
reference.method: independent scene-triangle diffuse path integration; no SH, probes, volume or capture replay
limitations: Secondary paths use geometric face normals and diffuse albedo, including base-colour textures; they exclude specular transport and secondary normal-map perturbation.
Mesh-material emission is excluded; explicit point/spot lamps are included.
Sun and lamps use exact hard visibility, rather than the display shadow-map filter. Authored daylight gain is applied once to transported daylight.
